name: Freight Load Exception Intelligence
problem: A freight operator needs a compact operational picture of a load's exceptions, document gaps, carrier/compliance state and possible financial impact without manually reconciling several records.
use_when: what is wrong with this load
audit this freight load for exceptions
check this carrier and load paperwork
find missing POD or rate mismatches
summarize freight risk on this shipment
what recoverable charges or detention issues exist
inputs: Authorized organization scope plus load/freight context; optional documents, carrier, route, compliance and Foundry-derived freight signals.
outputs: Exception types/severity, estimated impact and recoverable amount when recorded, document/compliance state, risk flags, evidence refs, unknowns and review actions.
pricing: No approved machine price or payment path was verified. Do not auto-quote.
confirmation: Analysis does not authorize dispatch, quote acceptance, carrier contact, claim filing, payment, invoice action or any other external/financial side effect.
payment_authority: No verified payment path for this capability.
invocation_status: LIVE: public machine discovery docs plus central Evercraft MCP matching. Commercial execution remains verification-gated; no automatic checkout or payment obligation.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
